pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/contest/view.rs:126 judges_lead publishes the max panel mean as the judges lean (shown to one decimal at LedgerVerdict.tsx:67) without checking the margin against the rows spread, so a lead inside the judges own disagreement is presented to the owner as a ranking

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/contest/view.rs:126 max_by over non-broken means with no margin-vs-spread check; ContestScoreRow.spread (src-tauri/src/commands/contest/arena.rs:387) is carried but never consulted, and an exact tie is resolved by iteration order
src-tauri/src/commands/contest/decide.rs:3 the winner is a declared owner verdict passed to contest.mjs verdict, not inferred from the scoreboard sort

src-tauri/src/commands/contest/create.rs:62 validate refuses duplicate judges and an empty enabled panel but does not check judge family against participants; the cross-family rule lives in the skill instrument (.claude/skills/contest/SKILL.md:217), outside this context

pairs.registryProposal: resolution-precondition speaks of within-condition SD from repeated trials; single-trial judged contests only have inter-judge spread (max-min). A sentence on using judge spread as the noise floor when trials=1 would make the rule directly testable for panel-judged contests.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/execution/tests.rs:57 start_test_run loads scenarios from suite_id but creates the run with persona_id and models only, so a run scores cannot be traced to the suite (or suite content) that produced them

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/execution/tests.rs:57 suite_id is dropped at run creation; the scenario identity the scores attach to is lost
src-tauri/src/commands/execution/assertions.rs:21 output-assertion vocabularies are closed and an unknown type is a Validation error rather than silently running a different deterministic check
src-tauri/src/commands/execution/tests.rs:57 nothing about the judge packet reaches the run record (consistent with the recorded test-runner-lab deviation at src-tauri/engine/src/eval.rs:616)

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/test_suites.rs:100 overwrites a suite scenarios in place under the same id with no version, and src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/test_runs.rs:63 records no suite id or scenario version on the run, so historical scores silently compare against a changed exam

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/test_suites.rs:100 scenarios = COALESCE(?3, scenarios) mutates the fixture under a stable identity
src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/test_runs.rs:63 persona_test_runs stores models_tested only; persona_test_results carries output_quality_score with no judge model or rubric version
src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/test_runs.rs:63 absolute scores are persisted without their instrument versions, so a plotted series cannot mark an instrument discontinuity

pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_settings/components/PersonaAssertionsSection.tsx:16 output assertions are runtime quality gates evaluated on every production run, not scenarios scored across versions; no declared scenario set, trials or judge exist here
